message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the fact: From 2011-2014, defendant Min used his position as director of an apartment to, together with Ren etc., premeditatedly set up various bonus distribution schemes to embezzle public funds from the apartment's off-book funds, total 64,000 RMB, Min personally got 25,500 RMB.

This is embezzlement of public funds (国有资产、公共财物) by a public official? The apartment likely is a public housing? It says "襄某公寓账外资金". Could be a public institution? The role is "主任" of the apartment. Likely a public official or staff of a public institution. The crime is "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds) or "职务侵占罪". In Chinese criminal law, if a public official uses his position to appropriate public funds, it's "挪用公款罪". If it's a non-public official but a person in charge of public funds, also "职务侵占罪". The fact says "私设各种奖金发放名义从襄某公寓账外资金中共同侵吞公款". So it's "挪用公款罪". Also "受贿罪"? No, they are not receiving bribes, they are embezzling. Could also be "共同犯罪" but the crime is still embezzlement. So answer: 挪用公款罪.

Thus output: [罪名]挪用公款罪<eoa>
